note: Wooded campground on US-4 in Chichester east of Concord, 9 miles from New Hampshire Motor Speedway, with a pool. Mostly seasonal; nights, weeks and months are also sold. No dogs during NASCAR race weeks, and no visiting dogs on race or holiday weekends. --Claude
summary: Operator site (undated rates): $45 nightly with water/electric/sewer, extra adult $8, weekly/monthly/seasonal rates, May 1 to Columbus Day, request-form booking with check deposit, cash only at check-in. Google 4.1 (76). Price passes. Imagery suggests a largely seasonal park; nightly share not measurable, estimated in the 10-50% band - keep with caveat. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: price passes - cheapest (and only) RV night $45 with full hookups, the same at the summer peak; operator rates page undated, read 2026-11-23. Not in the Good Sam directory cache; no gateway within 40 km. GOOGLE: 4.1 stars from 76 reviews ('Great Meadows Campground'). RV Life stored 4.0 (RV Life page: 139 sites, avg rate $34). Presence: operator website with phone 603-798-5124.

LONG-STAY (keep with caveat, reviewer call): nightly share NOT directly measurable. The home page leads 'Whether you are camping for a night, or a month, or prefer a fully serviced seasonal campsite'; the rates page sells daily $45, weekly $275, monthly $800 + electric and seasonal from $2,400; a 'Seasonal Application' form sits in the menu and the only blog post (2021) says 'Welcome back to all our seasonal campers!'. On Esri (43.2413,-71.3948) most occupied pads carry sheds, decks or screen rooms in a dense trailer layout; only a few bare pads are visible. Estimate: nightly share in the 10-50% band (likely the low end). Tests: no discouraging wording toward nightly guests, no standing minimum, RV nights sold by the night (not weekly-only), no age restriction (the 10-years-or-newer rule applies only to new seasonal campers' rigs; a 2023 rig passes). Not iffy on Google (4.1/76), though the website is thin (no site map, cash/check only).
hookups: water and sewer confirmed; electric amperage not stated by the operator (RV Life lists 50 amp; the reservation form asks 'RV Size & Amps Required'). Not written.
facilities: only dump written (operator rules). RV Life lists showers, restrooms, laundry, pool; not written from the aggregator.
Website: https://greatmeadow.camp/ unchanged; optional second line https://greatmeadow.camp/rates-info. PHONE 603-798-5124 confirmed (operator site, Google).
Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed (no open water by the loops on Esri; only a wooded brook channel ~250 m north-west of the pin).
Pin 43.24114,-71.39376 sits among the sites in the middle of the park (~160 m from the US-4 entrance at 43.2400,-71.3950); no move.
